title: 第483章 那一剑的锋芒第482章 诸天背锅第一人
content_zh:
石皓月犹豫了一下，旋即亲自赶往石族。
此时石族之内。
听完事情经过的石皓月有些违心的辩解道：
“七祖，此事恐怕有什么误会！”
“许小凡我了解，是个老实孩子，绝干不出此等人神共愤之事！”
石族七祖盯着石皓月看了好一会。
旋即冷笑道：
“老实孩子？”
“不见得吧......”
“这位许家少主的事迹，老夫也略有耳闻。”
“可谓是劣迹斑斑......无恶不做......”
“老夫还听说，其他几大势力的天骄，最近总遭人绑架勒索，听闻此事，便是那许小凡做的......”
闻言，石皓月皱眉道：
“绝无可能！”
“这孩子这段时间一直待在王城内修炼，断然没机会做下此等事情！”
“定然是有人恶意栽赃陷害！”
这番话石皓月说的却是格外笃定。
石族七祖却是不信。
“你说他清白便，他便清白？”
“石皓月，你真以为自己接管了噬神卫，就能指鹿为马，为所欲为了？”

石皓月表情变的难看起来。
“七祖，本宫好声好气与你说话，你莫要欺人太甚！”
“欺人太甚？”
石族七祖再度冷笑，旋即，一股恐怖气息自其体内散发而出，竟直接将石皓月压的跪在地上，无法起身。
“石皓月，你还真是翅膀硬了，敢与老夫顶嘴了？”
“你背后若没有我石族撑腰，你又算个什么东西？”
石皓月死死咬着嘴唇，心中无比憋屈，嘴角几乎要咬出血来。
只是最终，他还是没能说出哪怕一句话来。
毕竟，石族七祖说的也的确是事实。
她之所以能站在这个位置。
能够一定程度的与那些老家伙争锋。
不一定是她石皓月本身多有本事，而是因为她姓石。
仅此而已。
“不管此事是不是许小凡所为，总之，先将他擒住再说。”
石族七祖再度说道。
闻言，石皓月忽然抬起头，盯着石族七族道：
“七祖，万万不可！”
石族七祖挑眉道：
“为何不可？”
石皓月语速极快道：
content_en:
Shi Haoyue hesitated for a moment, then rushed to the Stone Clan in person.
At this time, within the Stone Clan.
After hearing what happened, Shi Haoyue argued somewhat against his will:
"Seventh Ancestor, I'm afraid there is some misunderstanding about this matter!"
"I understand Xu Xiaofan. He is an honest boy and would never do such a thing that would outrage both humans and gods!"
The seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan stared at Shi Haoyue for a long time.
Then he sneered and said:
"Honest boy?"
"Not necessarily..."
"I have heard a little about the deeds of this young master of the Xu family."
"It can be said that he has a bad record... he does all kinds of evil..."
"I also heard that the geniuses of several other major forces have been kidnapped and extorted recently. I heard that it was Xu Xiaofan who did it..."
Hearing this, Shi Haoyue frowned and said:
"Absolutely impossible!"
"This child has been practicing in the royal city during this period, and there is absolutely no chance for him to do such a thing!"
"There must be someone maliciously framing you!"
Shi Haoyue said these words with great certainty.
The seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan didn't believe it.
"If you say he is innocent, then he is innocent?"
"Shi Haoyue, do you really think that since you took over the God-Eating Guard, you can turn a deer into a horse and do whatever you want?"
Shi Haoyue's expression turned ugly.
"Seventh Ancestor, I am speaking to you in such a nice voice, please don't go too far!"
"Too much bullying?"
The seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan sneered again, and immediately, a terrifying aura emanated from his body, directly pressing Shi Haoyue to his knees on the ground, unable to get up.
"Shi Haoyue, you really have strong wings. Do you dare to talk back to me?"
"If you don't have the support of our Stone Clan behind you, who are you?"
Shi Haoyue bit her lip, feeling extremely aggrieved and almost bleeding from the corner of her mouth.
But in the end, he still couldn't say a single word.
After all, what the seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan said was indeed true.
The reason why she is in this position.
Able to compete with those old guys to a certain extent.
It's not necessarily because she, Shi Haoyue, is talented, but because her surname is Shi.
That's all.
"No matter whether Xu Xiaofan did this or not, in short, we need to capture him first."
The seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan said again.
Hearing this, Shi Haoyue suddenly raised his head, stared at the seven members of the Stone Clan and said:
"Seventh Patriarch, you must not do this!"
The seventh ancestor of the Stone Clan raised his eyebrows and said:
"Why not?"
Shi Haoyue spoke very quickly:
